summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to webhook.site
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that executes index.js on `npm install`. index.js reads os.hostname() and process.cwd() and POSTs them, along with a generated test identifier, to a hardcoded https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50 collector. webhook.site is a public third-party request-capture service that is commonly used as an install-time beacon sink. The behavior fires automatically on default install, is directed at a third-party endpoint unrelated to any declared publisher infrastructure, and discloses the installer's machine hostname and current working directory to whoever controls the webhook.site token. Self-descriptive strings in the payload (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`) are author-controlled and do not change the behavior: the shipped code performs unsolicited outbound exfiltration of host identifiers on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
